headline: Astronomers find possible new dwarf planet beyond Neptune
summary: Astronomers have identified 2026 ED138, an object beyond Neptune, as a possible new dwarf planet. One report says it could be up to 1,500 kilometers across, while another calls it perhaps the smallest known object of its type. Confirmation that it meets the criteria for a dwarf planet is still pending.
